summary: Explored two axes: model shape (DEPTH/width via ASPECT_RATIO) and LR warmdown schedule length, at fixed 5-minute budget. Both DEPTH=6 (width=512, val_bpb=1.031393) and DEPTH=10 (width=896, val_bpb=1.031865) were clearly worse than baseline DEPTH=8 (1.012347), confirming the baseline shape is near-optimal for this compute budget. Shortening WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 gave the best result (val_bpb=0.997177, ~1.5% relative improvement), while 0.2 (1.003240) and 0.4 (0.997303) bracket it, showing a shallow optimum around 0.3-0.4 rather than a sharp peak. Next things to try: combine WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3 with MATRIX_LR or WEIGHT_DECAY tuning, or try WARMUP_RATIO>0 since baseline currently has none.
